data.name: Billionaire Life Simulator
data.detailed_description:
WAKE UP IN A PENTHOUSE.

SLEEP ON A YACHT.

THE ALARM CLOCK IS A HELICOPTER.

Welcome to BILLIONAIRE LIFE SIMULATOR — the ultimate "what if

I had everything" sandbox, built in Unreal Engine to make the

fantasy look so good it almost feels real.

This isn't a clicker. This isn't a spreadsheet. This is the

life you scroll past on Instagram — and now you live it.

🍾 EVERY DAY, A NEW VERSION OF "TOO MUCH"

Wake up in a Manhattan penthouse. Have espresso flown in

from Italy. Take the elevator down to your private garage

and pick today's car — the McLaren or the matte-black

Rolls? Helicopter to the marina. Set sail to your private

island for lunch. Swim with whale sharks before dinner.

Then host a yacht party at sunset that someone will

absolutely film without your permission.

Tomorrow? You do something even more ridiculous.

🏰 BUILD AN EMPIRE OR JUST FLEX THE ONE YOU INHERITED

Your money has to come from somewhere. Build it from scratch

through investments, business acquisitions, and high-risk

deals — or skip the work entirely and drop into the lifestyle

mode where the only question is "what do I want to do today?"

Both modes. Same game. Your choice.

✈️ EVERY TOY YOU'VE EVER GOOGLED AT 2 AM

🛥️ Mega-yachts you can actually pilot

✈️ Private jets with full cabin walkthroughs

🚗 A garage of supercars worth more than your hometown

🏝️ Private islands you customize from sand up

🏰 Mansions, penthouses, ski chalets, beach villas

🎣 Deep-sea fishing, scuba diving, big-game hunting

🍽️ Michelin-tier private chefs and wine cellars

👔 Designer wardrobes that cost more than rent

Every asset is detailed. Every interior is customizable.

Every fantasy is on the menu.

👑 YOUR EMPIRE. YOUR RULES. YOUR PROBLEM.

Throw the most expensive birthday party of all time.

Buy a soccer team on a whim. Outfit your private army of

chefs. Sponsor a space launch. Adopt a tiger.

Or just sit on your balcony watching the sunset over your

fleet of yachts and wonder why you ever stressed about money.

The dream is yours.

The bill, for once, isn't.

Are you ready to live the life everyone scrolls past?

BILLIONAIRE LIFE SIMULATOR is the ultimate "what if I had everything" sandbox — pilot private jets, host yacht parties, customize mansions, and live the Instagram fantasy in cinematic Unreal Engine detail.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD R9 380 (2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / AMD RX 5600 XT (6 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
